title: research: wolfHSM backend does not retry on WH_ERROR_NOTREADY
description:
wolfHSM transport functions return WH_ERROR_NOTREADY (-2001) to mean 'retry — temporary condition'. wh_Client_Echo in the wolfHSM source uses an explicit do-while retry loop on NOTREADY (wh_client.c:560-565). wolfP11's wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c likely calls wh_Client_* once and maps any non-zero return to -1.

If the transport returns NOTREADY on a single call, wolfP11 will fail the sign/verify/decrypt operation permanently for that session, even though the correct behavior is to retry until the transport is ready or a timeout occurs.

Research needed: audit every wh_Client_* call in wp11_backend_wolfhsm.c to confirm whether NOTREADY is retried or propagated. If propagated, decide: (a) retry inside the backend with a bounded loop and a timeout, (b) return a wolfP11 error that the PKCS#11 layer can translate to CKR_DEVICE_BUSY with retry semantics, or (c) document that the caller must retry the PKCS#11 operation.

This is separate from wolfP11-0x1 (which is about error code mapping) — this is about retry policy.
